text.zh: 相关管制：(1) 以下全部物项“受ITAR管辖”（见《联邦法规》第22编第120至130部分）：
text.en: Related Controls: (1) All of the following are “subject to the ITAR” (see 22 CFR parts 120 through 130):

text.zh: a. 为军事用途“专门设计”的猛炸药及相关设备；
text.en: a. High explosives and related equipment “specially designed” for military use;

text.zh: b. 本条目中使用USML管制含能材料（见《联邦法规》第22编§121.1第V类）的爆炸装置或装药，如其专为军事应用设计、开发、配置、适配或改装；
text.en: b. Explosive devices or charges in this entry that utilize USML controlled energetic materials (See 22 CFR 121.1 Category V), if they have been specifically designed, developed, configured, adapted, or modified for a military application;

text.zh: c. 同时具有以下所有特征的聚能装药：形状均匀、夹角为90度或以下的锥形药型罩，含有超过2.0千克受管制材料，且直径大于4.5英寸；
text.en: c. Shaped charges that have all of the following a uniform shaped conical liner with an included angle of 90 degrees or less, more than 2.0 kg of controlled materials, and a diameter exceeding 4.5 inches;

text.zh: d. 每米含受管制材料超过0.1千克（每英尺470格令）的导爆索；
text.en: d. Detonating cord containing greater than 0.1 kg per meter (470 grains per foot) of controlled materials;

text.zh: e. 含有超过10千克受管制材料的切割器和切断工具；
text.en: e. Cutters and severing tools containing greater than 10 kg of controlled materials;

text.zh: f. 除切割器和切断工具外，本条目管制且可在不破坏装置或装药的情况下轻易提取其中USML管制材料的装置或装药；以及
text.en: f. With the exception of cutters and severing tools, devices or charges controlled by this entry where the USML controlled materials can be easily extracted without destroying the device or charge; and

text.zh: g. 本条目中的单独USML管制含能材料，即使与其他材料混合，在未装入本条目或1C992管制爆炸装置或装药时亦同。
text.en: g. Individual USML controlled energetic materials in this entry, even when compounded with other materials, when not incorporated into explosive devices or charges controlled by this entry or 1C992.

text.zh: (2) 其他受管制含能材料另见ECCN 1C011、1C018、1C111、1C239和1C608。ECCN 1A008管制商品的“开发”或“生产”“技术”，见ECCN 1E001；但“受ITAR管辖”的炸药或商品除外（见《联邦法规》第22编第120至130部分）。
text.en: (2) See also ECCNs 1C011, 1C018, 1C111, 1C239, and 1C608 for additional controlled energetic materials. See ECCN 1E001 for the “development” or “production” “technology” for the commodities controlled by ECCN 1A008, but not for explosives or commodities that are “subject to the ITAR” (see 22 CFR parts 120 through 130).

text.zh: 相关定义：不适用
text.en: Related Definitions: N/A

text.zh: 物项：
text.en: Items:

text.zh: a. 具有以下所有特征的‘聚能装药’：
text.en: a. 'Shaped charges' having all of the following:

text.zh: a.1. 净炸药量（NEQ）大于90克；以及
text.en: a.1. Net Explosive Quantity (NEQ) greater than 90 g; and

text.zh: a.2. 外壳直径等于或大于75毫米；
text.en: a.2. Outer casing diameter equal to or greater than 75 mm;

text.zh: b. 具有以下所有特征的线性聚能切割装药，以及为其“专门设计”的“部件”：
text.en: b. Linear shaped cutting charges having all of the following, and “specially designed” “components” therefor:

text.zh: b.1. 装药量大于40克/米；以及
text.en: b.1. An explosive load greater than 40 g/m; and

text.zh: b.2. 宽度为10毫米或以上；
text.en: b.2. A width of 10 mm or more;

text.zh: c. 炸药芯装药量大于64克/米的导爆索；
text.en: c. Detonating cord with explosive core load greater than 64 g/m;

text.zh: d. 1A008.b未规定、净炸药量大于3.5千克的切割器和切断工具。
text.en: d. Cutters, not specified by 1A008.b, and severing tools, having a NEQ greater than 3.5 kg.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就1A008.a而言，‘聚能装药’是通过成形使爆炸冲击效应集中的炸药装药。
text.en: For the purposes of 1A008.a, 'shaped charges' are explosive charges shaped to focus the effects of the explosive blast.

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 1A008仅规定含“炸药”（见第1类末尾附件中的炸药清单）及其混合物的装药和装置。
text.en: The only charges and devices specified in 1A008 are those containing “explosives” (see list of explosives in the Annex at the end of Category 1) and mixtures thereof.

text.en: Related Controls: (1) This entry does not control depleted uranium in fabricated forms for use in munitions. See 22 CFR part 121 for depleted uranium “subject to the ITAR. (2) Depleted uranium that is not fabricated for use in munitions or fabricated into commodities solely to take advantage of its high density (e.g., aircraft, ship, or other counterweights) or in the forms listed in this entry are subject to the export licensing authority of the Nuclear Regulatory Commission. (See 10 CFR part 110.) (3) “Natural uranium” or “depleted uranium” or thorium in the form of metal, alloy, chemical compound or concentrate and any other material containing one or more of the foregoing are subject to the export licensing authority of the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (see 10 CFR part 110).

text.en: Related Controls: (1) Vaccines identified in ECCN 1C991 are not controlled by this ECCN. (2) See 22 CFR 121.1 (USML), Category XIV(h), for vaccines that are subject to the ITAR. (3) Protection and detection equipment and related items identified in ECCN 1A004, 1A995, or 2B351 are not controlled by this ECCN. (4) See 22 CFR 121.1 (USML), Category XIV(f), for dissemination, detection and protection equipment that is subject to the ITAR. (5) See ECCN 0A919 for “military commodities” located and produced outside the United States that incorporate more than a de minimis amount of US-origin “600 series” controlled content.

text.zh: f. 防护“设备”（包括空调机组、防护涂层和防护服）：
text.en: f. Protection “equipment” (including air conditioning units, protective coatings, and protective clothing):

text.zh: f.1. 不受USML第XIV(f)类管制；以及
text.en: f.1. Not controlled by USML Category XIV(f); and

text.zh: f.2. 为军事用途及防御下列物质而“专门设计”：
text.en: f.2. “Specially designed” for military use and for defense against:

text.zh: f.2.1. USML第XIV(a)或(b)类规定的材料；或
text.en: f.2.1. Materials specified by USML Category XIV (a) or (b); or

text.en: g.2. “Specially designed” for military use and for decontamination of objects contaminated with materials controlled by USML Category XIV(a) or (b).

text.zh: h. “设备”：
text.en: h. “Equipment”:

text.zh: h.1. 不受USML第XIV(f)类管制；以及
text.en: h.1. Not controlled by USML Category XIV(f); and

text.zh: h.2. 为军事用途及探测或识别下列物质而“专门设计”：
text.en: h.2. “Specially designed” for military use and for the detection or identification of:

text.zh: h.2.1. USML第XIV(a)或(b)类规定的材料；或
text.en: h.2.1. Materials specified by USML Category XIV(a) or (b); or

text.zh: h.2.2. ECCN 1C607.a管制的防暴剂。
text.en: h.2.2. Riot control agents controlled by ECCN 1C607.a.

text.zh: j.1. 与USML或“600系列”ECCN管制的探测器、掩蔽设施、车辆、船舶或航空器连接；以及
text.en: j.1. Interface with a detector, shelter, vehicle, vessel, or aircraft controlled by the USML or a “600 series” ECCN; and

text.en: j.2. Collect and process samples of articles controlled in USML Category XIV(a) or (b).

text.zh: k. 为军事用途“专门设计”（包括预防和事后治疗、解毒剂及医学诊断），并为对抗USML第XIV(a)类管制化学战剂而“专门设计”的医疗应对措施。
text.en: k. Medical countermeasures that are “specially designed” for military use (including pre- and post-treatments, antidotes, and medical diagnostics) and “specially designed” to counter chemical agents controlled by the USML Category XIV(a).

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 本条目管制“设备”的示例包括防护屏障型和非屏障型乳膏，以及已装药的自动注射器（例如一支注射器含2-PAM、另一支含阿托品的组合注射笔），条件是其为对抗此类战剂而“专门设计”。
text.en: Examples of “equipment” controlled by this entry are barrier and non-barrier creams and filled autoinjectors (e.g., combopens where one injector contains 2-PAM and the other atropine) if “specially designed” to counter such agents.

text.zh: l.至w. [保留]
text.en: l. through w. [Reserved]

text.en: x. “Parts,” “components,” “accessories,” and “attachments” that are “specially designed” for a commodity controlled by ECCN 1A607.e, .f, .g, .h, or .j or for a defense article controlled by USML Category XIV(f) and that are not enumerated or otherwise described elsewhere in the USML.

text.zh: 相关管制：(1) ITAR下USML第X或XIII类管制的防务物品（如依据保密信息制成的材料）及其直接相关技术数据（包括软件）“受ITAR管辖”。(2) 含有超过最低比例门槛的美国原产“600系列”受管制内容的外国制造“军事商品”，见ECCN 0A919。(3) 抗过载服（“G-suits”）及能在海拔高于55,000英尺处工作的压力服，见ECCN 9A610.g。(4) 1A613.c未规定的其他军用头盔“部件”或“配件”，见CCL中的相关ECCN或USML条目。
text.en: Related Controls: (1) Defense articles, such as materials made from classified information, that are controlled by USML Category X or XIII of the ITAR, and technical data (including software) directly related thereto, are “subject to the ITAR.” (2) See ECCN 0A919 for foreign-made “military commodities” that incorporate more than a de minimis amount of US-origin “600 series” controlled content. (3) See ECCN 9A610.g for anti-gravity suits (“G-suits”) and pressure suits capable of operating at altitudes higher than 55,000 feet above sea level. (4) For other military helmet “components” or “accessories” not specified in 1A613.c, see the relevant ECCN in the CCL or USML Entry.

text.zh: 相关定义：提及“NIJ型”防护，是指美国国家司法研究所NIJ标准0101.06《防弹衣的防弹性能》和NIJ标准0108.01《防弹防护材料》中的分类指南。
text.en: Related Definitions: References to “NIJ Type” protection are to the National Institute of Justice Classification guide at NIJ Standard 0101.06, Ballistic Resistance of Body Armor, and NIJ Standard 0108.01, Ballistic Resistant Protective Materials.

text.zh: 物项：
text.en: Items:

text.zh: a. 为军事用途“专门设计”且不受USML管制的金属或非金属装甲板。
text.en: a. Metallic or non-metallic armored plate “specially designed” for military use and not controlled by the USML.

text.zh: a款注：
text.en: Note to paragraph a:

text.zh: 防弹衣插板的管制，见ECCN 1A613.d.2和USML第X(a)(1)类。
text.en: For controls on body armor plates, see ECCN 1A613.d.2 and USML Category X(a)(1).

text.zh: b. 为下列用途“专门设计”的掩蔽设施：
text.en: b. Shelters “specially designed” to:

text.zh: b.1. 为军事系统提供弹道防护；或
text.en: b.1. Provide ballistic protection for military systems; or

text.zh: b.2. 防护核、生物或化学污染。
text.en: b.2. Protect against nuclear, biological, or chemical contamination.

text.zh: c. 提供低于NIJ IV型或“同等标准”防护的军用头盔（1A613.y.1管制头盔除外）。
text.en: c. Military helmets (other than helmets controlled under 1A613.y.1) providing less than NIJ Type IV or “equivalent standards” protection.
Note 1:

text.zh: 警用头盔的管制，见ECCN 0A979。
text.en: See ECCN 0A979 for controls on police helmets.

text.zh: 注2：其他军用头盔的管制，见USML第X(a)(5)和(a)(6)类。
text.en: Note 2: See USML Category X(a)(5) and (a)(6) for controls on other military helmets.

text.zh: 注3：1A613.c不适用于满足以下所有条件的头盔：
text.en: Note 3: 1A613.c does not apply to helmets that meet all the following:

text.zh: a. 首次制造于1970年之前；以及
text.en: a. Were first manufactured before 1970; and

text.zh: b. 既未设计或改装用于安装，也未配备《美国军品清单》（《联邦法规》第22编第121部分）或其他“600系列”ECCN规定的物项。
text.en: b. Are neither designed or modified to accept, nor equipped with items specified by the U.S. Munitions List (22 CFR 121) or another “600 series” ECCN.

text.zh: d. 下列防弹衣和防护服：
text.en: d. Body armor and protective garments, as follows:

text.zh: d.1. 按军事标准、规格或其等效标准制造，并提供等于或低于NIJ III级（NIJ 0101.06，2008年7月）或“同等标准”弹道防护的软质防弹衣和防护服；或
text.en: d.1. Soft body armor and protective garments manufactured to military standards or specifications, or to their equivalents, that provide ballistic protection equal to or less than NIJ level III (NIJ 0101.06, July 2008) or “equivalent standards”; or

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 就1A613.d.1而言，军事标准或规格至少包括破片防护规格。
text.en: For 1A613.d.1, military standards or specifications include, at a minimum, specifications for fragmentation protection.

text.zh: d.2. 提供等于NIJ III级（NIJ 0101.06，2008年7月）或“同等标准”弹道防护的硬质防弹板。
text.en: d.2. Hard body armor plates that provide ballistic protection equal to NIJ level III (NIJ 0101.06, July 2008) or “equivalent standards”.

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 非按军事标准或规格制造的软质防弹衣，以及提供低于NIJ III级或“同等标准”防护的硬质防弹板的管制，见ECCN 1A005。提供NIJ IV型或以上防护的防弹衣，见USML第X(a)(1)类。
text.en: See ECCN 1A005 for controls on soft body armor not manufactured to military standards or specifications and hard body armor plates providing less than NIJ level III or “equivalent standards” protection. For body armor providing NIJ Type IV protection or greater, see USML Category X(a)(1).

text.zh: e. 为USML或CCL管制潜艇的救援行动“专门设计”的常压潜水服。
text.en: e. Atmospheric diving suits “specially designed” for rescue operations for submarines controlled by the USML or the CCL.

text.zh: f. 为军事应用“专门设计”、不受USML管制且CCL未在其他处管制的其他个人防护“设备”。
text.en: f. Other personal protective “equipment” “specially designed” for military applications not controlled by the USML, not elsewhere controlled on the CCL.

text.zh: g.至w. [保留]
text.en: g. to w. [Reserved]

text.zh: x. 为ECCN 1A613（1A613.y除外）管制商品或USML第X类列举物品“专门设计”，且USML未在其他处管制的“零件”“部件”“配件”和“附属装置”。
text.en: x. “Parts,” “components,” “accessories,” and “attachments” that are “specially designed” for a commodity controlled by ECCN 1A613 (except for 1A613.y) or an article enumerated in USML Category X, and not controlled elsewhere in the USML.

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 1A613.x包括制造进度已达到可根据机械性能、材料组成、几何形状或功能明确识别为ECCN 1A613.x规定商品的锻件、铸件及其他未完成制品，例如挤压件和机加工坯体。
text.en: 1A613.x includes forgings, castings, and other unfinished products, such as extrusions and machined bodies, that have reached a stage in manufacturing where they are clearly identifiable by mechanical properties, material composition, geometry, or function as commodities specified in ECCN 1A613.x.

text.zh: y. 下列其他商品：
text.en: y. Other commodities as follows:

text.zh: y.1 常规军用钢盔。
text.en: y.1 Conventional military steel helmets.

text.zh: 注：1A613.y.1不适用于满足以下所有条件的头盔：
text.en: Note: 1A613.y.1 does not apply to helmets that meet all the following:

text.zh: a. 首次制造于1970年之前；以及
text.en: a. Were first manufactured before 1970; and

text.zh: b. 既未设计或改装用于安装，也未配备《美国军品清单》（《联邦法规》第22编第121部分）或其他“600系列”ECCN规定的物项。
text.en: b. Are neither designed or modified to accept, nor equipped with items specified by the U.S. Munitions List (22 CFR 121) or another “600 series” ECCN.

text.zh: y.1款注意：其他军用头盔“部件”或“配件”，见CCL中的相关ECCN或USML条目。
text.en: N.B. to paragraph y.1: For other military helmet “components” or “accessories,” see the relevant ECCN in the CCL or USML Entry.

text.zh: 物项：
text.en: Items:

text.zh: a. 为使用“纤维或丝状材料”制造“复合材料”结构或层压制品而“专门设计”的纤维缠绕机，其纤维定位、包绕和缠绕运动可在三个或以上‘主要伺服定位’轴上协调并编程；
text.en: a. Filament winding machines, of which the motions for positioning, wrapping and winding fibers are coordinated and programmed in three or more 'primary servo positioning' axes, “specially designed” for the manufacture of “composite” structures or laminates, from “fibrous or filamentary materials”;

text.zh: b. 为制造“复合材料”机体或导弹结构而“专门设计”的‘铺带机’，其定位和铺带运动可在五个或以上‘主要伺服定位’轴上协调并编程；
text.en: b. 'Tape laying machines', of which the motions for positioning and laying tape are coordinated and programmed in five or more 'primary servo positioning' axes, “specially designed” for the manufacture of “composite” airframe or missile structures;

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就1B001.b而言，‘铺带机’能够铺放一条或多条宽度限于大于25.4毫米且小于或等于304.8毫米的‘丝束带’，并能在铺放过程中切断和重新开始单条‘丝束带’的铺放路径。
text.en: For the purposes of 1B001.b, 'tape-laying machines' have the ability to lay one or more 'filament bands' limited to widths greater than 25.4 mm and less than or equal to 304.8 mm, and to cut and restart individual 'filament band' courses during the laying process.

text.zh: c. 为编织、交织或编结“复合材料”结构用纤维而“专门设计”或改装的多向、多维编织机或交织机，包括适配器和改装套件；
text.en: c. Multidirectional, multidimensional weaving machines or interlacing machines, including adapters and modification kits, “specially designed” or modified for weaving, interlacing or braiding fibers for “composite” structures;

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就1B001.c而言，交织技术包括针织。
text.en: For the purposes of 1B001.c the technique of interlacing includes knitting.

text.zh: d. 为生产增强纤维而“专门设计”或适配的下列设备：
text.en: d. Equipment “specially designed” or adapted for the production of reinforcement fibers, as follows:

text.zh: d.1. 将聚合物纤维（如聚丙烯腈、人造丝、沥青或聚碳硅烷）转化为碳纤维或碳化硅纤维的设备，包括加热期间对纤维施加张力的专用设备；
text.en: d.1. Equipment for converting polymeric fibers (such as polyacrylonitrile, rayon, pitch or polycarbosilane) into carbon fibers or silicon carbide fibers, including special equipment to strain the fiber during heating;

text.zh: d.2. 在加热的丝状基材上通过化学气相沉积元素或化合物制造碳化硅纤维的设备；
text.en: d.2. Equipment for the chemical vapor deposition of elements or compounds, on heated filamentary substrates, to manufacture silicon carbide fibers;

text.zh: d.3. 耐火陶瓷（如氧化铝）湿法纺丝设备；
text.en: d.3. Equipment for the wet-spinning of refractory ceramics (such as aluminum oxide);

text.zh: d.4. 通过热处理将含铝前驱体纤维转化为氧化铝纤维的设备；
text.en: d.4. Equipment for converting aluminum containing precursor fibers into alumina fibers by heat treatment;

text.zh: e. 采用热熔法生产1C010.e管制预浸料的设备；
text.en: e. Equipment for producing prepregs controlled by 1C010.e by the hot melt method;

text.zh: f. 为“复合材料”“专门设计”的下列无损检测设备：
text.en: f. Non-destructive inspection equipment “specially designed” for “composite” materials, as follows:

text.zh: f.1. 用于三维缺陷检查的X射线断层成像系统；
text.en: f.1. X-ray tomography systems for three dimensional defect inspection;

text.zh: f.2. 数控超声检测机，其发射器或接收器的定位运动可在四个或以上轴上同时协调并编程，以沿被检“零件”或“部件”的三维轮廓运动；
text.en: f.2. Numerically controlled ultrasonic testing machines of which the motions for positioning transmitters or receivers are simultaneously coordinated and programmed in four or more axes to follow the three dimensional contours of the “part” or “component” under inspection;

text.zh: g. 为制造“复合材料”机体或导弹结构而“专门设计”的铺丝机，其定位和铺丝运动可在两个或以上‘主要伺服定位’轴上协调并编程。
text.en: g. Tow-placement machines, of which the motions for positioning and laying tows are coordinated and programmed in two or more 'primary servo positioning' axes, “specially designed” for the manufacture of “composite” airframe or missile structures.

text.zh: 1B001.g技术注：
text.en: Technical Note to 1B001.g:

text.zh: 就1B001.g而言，‘铺丝机’能够铺放一条或多条宽度小于或等于25.4毫米的‘丝束带’，并能在铺放过程中切断和重新开始单条‘丝束带’的铺放路径。
text.en: For the purposes of 1B001.g, 'tow-placement machines' have the ability to place one or more 'filament bands' having widths less than or equal to 25.4 mm, and to cut and restart individual 'filament band' courses during the placement process.

text.zh: 1B001技术注：
text.en: Technical Notes for 1B001:

text.zh: 1. 就1B001而言，‘主要伺服定位’轴在计算机“程序”指令下控制末端执行器（即头部）相对于工件的空间位置，使其处于正确姿态和方向，以实现所需工艺。
text.en: 1. For the purposes of 1B001, 'primary servo positioning' axes control, under computer “program” direction, the position of the end effector (i.e., head) in space relative to the work piece at the correct orientation and direction to achieve the desired process.

text.zh: 2. 就1B001而言，‘丝束带’是一条具有连续宽度、完全或部分浸渍树脂的带材、丝束或纤维。完全或部分浸渍树脂的‘丝束带’包括涂覆加热后具有黏性的干粉者。
text.en: 2. For the purposes of 1B001, a 'filament band' is a single continuous width of fully or partially resin-impregnated tape, tow or fiber. Fully or partially resin-impregnated 'filament bands' include those coated with dry powder that tacks upon heating.

text.zh: 相关定义：本条目管制机器的“零件”“部件”和配件，例如用于复合材料结构、层压制品及其制成品的预成型压制、固化、浇铸、烧结或粘接的铸模、芯轴、模具、夹具和工装。
text.en: Related Definitions: Examples of “parts,” “components” and accessories for the machines controlled by this entry are molds, mandrels, dies, fixtures and tooling for the preform pressing, curing, casting, sintering or bonding of composite structures, laminates and manufactures thereof.

text.zh: 物项：a. 设计用于由纤维或丝状材料制造复合材料结构或层压制品的纤维缠绕机或‘纤维/丝束铺放机’，其纤维定位、包绕和缠绕运动可在三个或以上轴上协调并编程；以及协调与编程控制器；
text.en: Items: a. Filament winding machines or 'fiber/tow-placement machines,' of which the motions for positioning, wrapping and winding fibers can be coordinated and programmed in three or more axes, designed to fabricate composite structures or laminates from fibrous or filamentary materials, and coordinating and programming controls;

text.zh: b. 设计用于制造复合材料机体和导弹结构的‘铺带机’，其定位和铺带运动可在两个或以上轴上协调并编程；
text.en: b. 'Tape-laying machines' of which the motions for positioning and laying tape can be coordinated and programmed in two or more axes, designed for the manufacture of composite airframe and missile structures;

text.zh: a款和b款技术注：
text.en: Technical Notes for paragraphs a and b:

blocks.noteHeading: Technical Notes for paragraphs a and b:

text.zh: 就1B101.a和1B101.b而言，适用以下定义：
text.en: For the purposes of 1B101.a. and 1B101.b., the following definitions apply:

blocks.noteHeading: Technical Notes for paragraphs a and b:

text.zh: 1. ‘纤维/丝束铺放机’和‘铺带机’执行类似工艺，利用计算机引导的头部将一条或数条‘丝束带’铺到模具上，以形成零件或结构。这些机器能在铺放过程中切断并重新开始单条‘丝束带’的铺放路径。
text.en: 1. 'Fiber/tow-placement machines' and 'tape-laying machines' are machines that perform similar processes that use computer-guided heads to lay one or several 'filament bands' onto a mold to create a part or a structure. These machines have the ability to cut and restart individual 'filament band' courses during the laying process.

blocks.noteHeading: Technical Notes for paragraphs a and b:

text.zh: 2. ‘丝束带’是一条具有连续宽度、完全或部分浸渍树脂的带材、丝束或纤维。完全或部分浸渍树脂的‘丝束带’包括涂覆加热后具有黏性的干粉者。
text.en: 2. A 'filament band' is a single continuous width of fully or partially resin-impregnated tape, tow, or fiber. Fully or partially resin-impregnated 'filament bands' include those coated with dry powder that tacks upon heating.

blocks.noteHeading: Technical Notes for paragraphs a and b:

text.zh: 3. ‘纤维/丝束铺放机’能够铺放一条或多条宽度小于或等于25.4毫米的‘丝束带’。这指机器能够铺放的材料最小宽度，不论机器最大能力为何。
text.en: 3. 'Fiber/tow-placement machines' have the ability to place one or more 'filament bands' having widths less than or equal to 25.4 mm. This refers to the minimum width of material the machine can place, regardless of the upper capability of the machine.

blocks.noteHeading: Technical Notes for paragraphs a and b:

text.zh: 4. ‘铺带机’能够铺放一条或多条宽度小于或等于304.8毫米的‘丝束带’，但不能铺放宽度等于或小于25.4毫米的‘丝束带’。这指机器能够铺放的材料最小宽度，不论机器最大能力为何。
text.en: 4. 'Tape-laying machines' have the ability to place one or more 'filament bands' having widths less than or equal to 304.8 mm, but cannot place 'filament bands' with a width equal to or less than 25.4 mm. This refers to the minimum width of material the machine can place, regardless of the upper capability of the machine.

blocks.noteHeading: Technical Notes for paragraphs a and b:

text.zh: c. 为“生产”“纤维或丝状材料”而设计或改装的下列设备：
text.en: c. Equipment designed or modified for the “production” of “fibrous or filamentary materials” as follows:

text.zh: c.1. 转化聚合物纤维（如聚丙烯腈、人造丝或聚碳硅烷）的设备，包括加热期间对纤维施加张力的专门配置；
text.en: c.1. Equipment for converting polymeric fibers (such as polyacrylonitrile, rayon or polycarbosilane) including special provision to strain the fiber during heating;

text.zh: c.2. 在加热丝状基材上进行元素或化合物气相沉积的设备；以及
text.en: c.2. Equipment for the vapor deposition of elements or compounds on heated filament substrates; and

text.zh: c.3. 耐火陶瓷（如氧化铝）湿法纺丝设备；
text.en: c.3. Equipment for the wet-spinning of refractory ceramics (such as aluminum oxide);

text.zh: d. 为特殊纤维表面处理，或为生产9A110管制预浸料和预成型件而设计或改装的设备。
text.en: d. Equipment designed or modified for special fiber surface treatment or for producing prepregs and preforms controlled by 9A110.

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 1B101.d涵盖设备包括但不限于辊筒、张力拉伸装置、涂覆设备、切割设备和冲裁模具。
text.en: Equipment covered in 1B101.d includes but is not limited to, rollers, tension stretchers, coating equipment, cutting equipment and clicker dies.

text.en: Related Definitions: (1) The term “fine grain stainless steels,” for purposes of this ECCN, means fine grain austenitic stainless steels with an ASTM (or equivalent standard) grain size number of 5 or greater. text.en: Related Controls: (1) See ECCN 1E001 (“development” and “production”) and ECCN 1E201 (“use”) for technology for items described in this entry. (2) Facilities and plants described in 1B233.a are subject to the export licensing authority of the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (see 10 CFR part 110). (3) Certain lithium isotope separation equipment and components for the plasma separation process (PSP) that are described in 1B233.b through .d are also directly applicable to uranium isotope separation and are subject to the export licensing authority of the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (see 10 CFR part 110).

text.zh: 物项：a. 用于分离锂同位素的设施或工厂；
text.en: Items: a. Facilities or plants for the separation of lithium isotopes;

text.zh: b. 基于锂—汞齐工艺分离锂同位素的下列设备：
text.en: b. Equipment for the separation of lithium isotopes based on the lithium-mercury amalgam process, as follows:

text.zh: b.1. 为锂汞齐“专门设计”的填料式液—液交换塔；
text.en: b.1. Packed liquid-liquid exchange columns “specially designed” for lithium amalgams;

text.zh: b.2. 汞和/或锂汞齐泵；
text.en: b.2. Mercury and/or lithium amalgam pumps;

text.zh: b.3. 锂汞齐电解槽；
text.en: b.3. Lithium amalgam electrolysis cells;

text.zh: b.4. 氢氧化锂浓溶液蒸发器。
text.en: b.4. Evaporators for concentrated lithium hydroxide solution.

text.zh: c. 为锂同位素分离“专门设计”的离子交换系统，以及为其“专门设计”的组成零件；
text.en: c. Ion exchange systems “specially designed” for lithium isotope separation, and “specially designed” component parts therefor;

text.zh: d. 为锂同位素分离“专门设计”的化学交换系统（使用冠醚、穴醚或套索醚），以及为其“专门设计”的组成零件。
text.en: d. Chemical exchange systems (employing crown ethers, cryptands, or lariat ethers) “specially designed” for lithium isotope separation, and “specially designed” component parts therefor.

text.en: Items: a. “Equipment” “specially designed” for the “development,” “production,” repair, overhaul, or refurbishing of items controlled by ECCN 1C608 or USML Category V and not elsewhere specified on the USML.

text.zh: a款注：

text.zh: ECCN 1B608.a包括：(1) 连续硝化器；(2) 脱水压力机；
text.en: ECCN 1B608.a. includes: (1) Continuous nitrators; (2) dehydration presses;

text.zh: (3) 用于将挤出推进剂切割成规定尺寸的切割机；(4) 直径为6英尺或以上、产品容量超过500磅的滚筒；(5) 用于转化USML第V(c)(2)类所列材料的对流转换器；以及(6) 用于挤出轻武器、火炮和火箭推进剂的挤压机。
text.en: (3) cutting machines for the sizing of extruded propellants; (4) sweetie barrels (tumblers) 6 feet or more in diameter and having over 500 pounds product capacity; (5) convection current converters for the conversion of materials listed in USML Category V(c)(2); and (6) extrusion presses for the extrusion of small arms, cannon and rocket propellants.

text.zh: 物项：
text.en: Items:

text.zh: a. 用于吸收频率大于2 × 10^{8} Hz但小于3 × 10^{12} Hz的材料。
text.en: a. Materials for absorbing frequencies exceeding 2 × 10^{8} Hz but less than 3 × 10^{12} Hz.
Note 1:

text.zh: 1C001.a不管制：
text.en: 1C001.a does not control:

text.zh: a. 由天然或合成纤维构成、以非磁性填料实现吸收的毛发型吸收体；
text.en: a. Hair type absorbers, constructed of natural or synthetic fibers, with non-magnetic loading to provide absorption;

text.zh: b. 无磁损耗且入射表面为非平面形状的吸收体，包括金字塔形、圆锥形、楔形和褶皱表面；
text.en: b. Absorbers having no magnetic loss and whose incident surface is non-planar in shape, including pyramids, cones, wedges and convoluted surfaces;

text.zh: c. 具有以下所有特征的平面吸收体：
text.en: c. Planar absorbers, having all of the following:

text.zh: 1. 由以下任一种材料制成：
text.en: 1. Made from any of the following:

text.zh: a. 含碳填料的塑料泡沫材料（柔性或非柔性），或包括粘合剂在内的有机材料，在超过入射能量中心频率±15%的带宽内，其回波超过金属回波的5%，且不能耐受高于450 K（177 °C）的温度；或
text.en: a. Plastic foam materials (flexible or non-flexible) with carbon-loading, or organic materials, including binders, providing more than 5% echo compared with metal over a bandwidth exceeding ±15% of the center frequency of the incident energy, and not capable of withstanding temperatures exceeding 450 K (177 °C); or

text.zh: b. 陶瓷材料，在超过入射能量中心频率±15%的带宽内，其回波超过金属回波的20%，且不能耐受高于800 K（527 °C）的温度；
text.en: b. Ceramic materials providing more than 20% echo compared with metal over a bandwidth exceeding ±15% of the center frequency of the incident energy, and not capable of withstanding temperatures exceeding 800 K (527 °C);

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就1C001.a注1.c.1而言，吸收测试样品应为正方形，每边至少为中心频率波长的5倍，并置于辐射元件的远场。
text.en: For the purposes of 1C001.a Note 1.c.1, absorption test samples should be a square at least 5 wavelengths of the center frequency on a side and positioned in the far field of the radiating element.
2. Tensile strength less than 7 × 10^{6} N/m^{2}; and
3. Compressive strength less than 14 × 10^{6} N/m^{2};

text.zh: d. 由烧结铁氧体制成、具有以下所有特征的平面吸收体：
text.en: d. Planar absorbers made of sintered ferrite, having all of the following:

text.zh: 1. 比重大于4.4；以及
text.en: 1. A specific gravity exceeding 4.4; and

text.zh: 2. 最高工作温度为548 K（275 °C）或以下；
text.en: 2. A maximum operating temperature of 548 K (275 °C) or less;

text.zh: e. 无磁损耗，且由密度为0.15克/cm^{3}或以下的‘开孔泡沫’塑料材料制成的平面吸收体。
text.en: e. Planar absorbers having no magnetic loss and fabricated from 'open-cell foams' plastic material with a density of 0.15 grams/cm^{3} or less.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就1C001.a注e而言，‘开孔泡沫’是内部结构与大气相通的柔性多孔材料。‘开孔泡沫’亦称网状泡沫。
text.en: For the purposes of 1C001.a Note e., 'open-cell foams' are flexible and porous materials, having an inner structure open to the atmosphere. 'Open-cell foams' are also known as reticulated foams.
Note 2:

text.zh: 注1中的任何内容均不解除对涂料中用于提供吸收作用的磁性材料的管制。
text.en: Nothing in Note 1 releases magnetic materials to provide absorption when contained in paint.

text.zh: b. 对可见光不透明，且为吸收波长大于810纳米但小于2,000纳米（频率大于150 THz但小于370 THz）的近红外辐射而“专门设计”的材料；
text.en: b. Materials not transparent to visible light and “specially designed” for absorbing near-infrared radiation having a wavelength exceeding 810 nm but less than 2,000 nm (frequencies exceeding 150 THz but less than 370 THz);

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 1C001.b不适用于为以下任一种应用“专门设计”或配制的材料：
text.en: 1C001.b does not apply to materials, “specially designed” or formulated for any of the following applications:

text.zh: a. 聚合物“激光”打标；或
text.en: a. “Laser” marking of polymers; or

text.zh: b. 聚合物“激光”焊接。
text.en: b. “Laser” welding of polymers.

text.zh: c. 基于以下任一种聚合物、‘体电导率’大于10,000 S/m（西门子/米）或‘薄层（表面）电阻率’小于100欧姆/方块的本征导电聚合物材料：
text.en: c. Intrinsically conductive polymeric materials with a 'bulk electrical conductivity' exceeding 10,000 S/m (Siemens per meter) or a 'sheet (surface) resistivity' of less than 100 ohms/square, based on any of the following polymers:

text.zh: c.1. 聚苯胺；
text.en: c.1. Polyaniline;

text.zh: c.2. 聚吡咯；
text.en: c.2. Polypyrrole;

text.zh: c.3. 聚噻吩；
text.en: c.3. Polythiophene;

text.zh: c.4. 聚苯撑乙烯；或
text.en: c.4. Poly phenylene-vinylene; or

text.zh: c.5. 聚噻吩撑乙烯。
text.en: c.5. Poly thienylene-vinylene.

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 1C001.c不适用于液态材料。
text.en: 1C001.c does not apply to materials in a liquid form.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就1C001.c而言，‘体电导率’和‘薄层（表面）电阻率’应依据ASTM D-257或国家等效标准确定。
text.en: For the purposes of 1C001.c, 'bulk electrical conductivity' and 'sheet (surface) resistivity' should be determined using ASTM D-257 or national equivalents.

text.zh: 物项：
text.en: Items:

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 1C002不管制专为涂覆用途配制的金属合金、金属合金粉末和合金化材料。
text.en: 1C002 does not control metal alloys, metal alloy powder and alloyed materials, specially formulated for coating purposes.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就1C002而言，金属合金是指所述金属的重量百分比高于任何其他元素的合金。
text.en: For the purposes of 1C002, metal alloys are those containing a higher percentage by weight of the stated metal than of any other element.

text.zh: a. 下列铝化物：
text.en: a. Aluminides, as follows:

text.zh: a.1. 铝含量按重量计最低15%、最高38%，且含有至少一种其他合金元素的镍铝化物；
text.en: a.1. Nickel aluminides containing a minimum of 15% by weight aluminum, a maximum of 38% by weight aluminum and at least one additional alloying element;

text.zh: a.2. 铝含量按重量计为10%或以上，且含有至少一种其他合金元素的钛铝化物；
text.en: a.2. Titanium aluminides containing 10% by weight or more aluminum and at least one additional alloying element;

text.zh: b. 由1C002.c管制粉末或颗粒材料制成的下列金属合金：
text.en: b. Metal alloys, as follows, made from the powder or particulate material controlled by 1C002.c:

text.zh: b.1. 具有以下任一特征的镍合金：
text.en: b.1. Nickel alloys having any of the following:

text.zh: b.1.a. 在923 K（650 °C）、676 MPa应力下，‘持久断裂寿命’为10,000小时或以上；或
text.en: b.1.a. A 'stress-rupture life' of 10,000 hours or longer at 923 K (650 °C) at a stress of 676 MPa; or

text.zh: b.1.b. 在823 K（550 °C）、最大应力1,095 MPa下，‘低周疲劳寿命’为10,000次循环或以上；
text.en: b.1.b. A 'low cycle fatigue life' of 10,000 cycles or more at 823 K (550 °C) at a maximum stress of 1,095 MPa;

text.zh: b.2. 具有以下任一特征的铌合金：
text.en: b.2. Niobium alloys having any of the following:

text.zh: b.2.a. 在1,073 K（800 °C）、400 MPa应力下，‘持久断裂寿命’为10,000小时或以上；或
text.en: b.2.a. A 'stress-rupture life' of 10,000 hours or longer at 1,073 K (800 °C) at a stress of 400 MPa; or

text.zh: b.2.b. 在973 K（700 °C）、最大应力700 MPa下，‘低周疲劳寿命’为10,000次循环或以上；
text.en: b.2.b. A 'low cycle fatigue life' of 10,000 cycles or more at 973 K (700 °C) at a maximum stress of 700 MPa;

text.zh: b.3. 具有以下任一特征的钛合金：
text.en: b.3. Titanium alloys having any of the following:

text.zh: b.3.a. 在723 K（450 °C）、200 MPa应力下，‘持久断裂寿命’为10,000小时或以上；或
text.en: b.3.a. A 'stress-rupture life' of 10,000 hours or longer at 723 K (450 °C) at a stress of 200 MPa; or

text.zh: b.3.b. 在723 K（450 °C）、最大应力400 MPa下，‘低周疲劳寿命’为10,000次循环或以上；
text.en: b.3.b. A 'low cycle fatigue life' of 10,000 cycles or more at 723 K (450 °C) at a maximum stress of 400 MPa;

text.zh: b.4 具有以下任一特征的铝合金：
text.en: b.4 Aluminum alloys having any of the following:

text.zh: b.4.a. 在473 K（200 °C）下，抗拉强度为240 MPa或以上；或
text.en: b.4.a. A tensile strength of 240 MPa or more at 473 K (200 °C); or

text.zh: b.4.b. 在298 K（25 °C）下，抗拉强度为415 MPa或以上；
text.en: b.4.b. A tensile strength of 415 MPa or more at 298 K (25 °C);

text.zh: b.5. 具有以下所有特征的镁合金：
text.en: b.5. Magnesium alloys having all the following:

text.zh: b.5.a. 抗拉强度为345 MPa或以上；以及
text.en: b.5.a. A tensile strength of 345 MPa or more; and

text.zh: b.5.b. 依据ASTM G-31或国家等效标准测量，在3%氯化钠水溶液中的腐蚀速率小于1毫米/年；
text.en: b.5.b. A corrosion rate of less than 1 mm/year in 3% sodium chloride aqueous solution measured in accordance with ASTM standard G-31 or national equivalents;

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Notes:

text.zh: 就1C002.b而言：
text.en: For the purposes of 1C002.b:

text.zh: 1. ‘持久断裂寿命’应依据ASTM E-139或国家等效标准测量。
text.en: 1. 'Stress-rupture life' should be measured in accordance with ASTM standard E-139 or national equivalents.

text.zh: 2. ‘低周疲劳寿命’应依据ASTM E-606《恒定幅值低周疲劳试验推荐规程》或国家等效标准测量。试验应为轴向，平均应力比等于1，应力集中系数（K_{t}）等于1。平均应力比定义为最大应力减去最小应力后再除以最大应力。
text.en: 2. 'Low cycle fatigue life' should be measured in accordance with ASTM Standard E-606 'Recommended Practice for Constant-Amplitude Low-Cycle Fatigue Testing' or national equivalents. Testing should be axial with an average stress ratio equal to 1 and a stress-concentration factor (K_{t}) equal to 1. The average stress ratio is defined as maximum stress minus minimum stress divided by maximum stress.

text.zh: c. 具有以下所有特征的金属合金粉末或颗粒材料：
text.en: c. Metal alloy powder or particulate material, having all of the following:

text.zh: c.1. 由以下任一种组成体系制成：
text.en: c.1. Made from any of the following composition systems:

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就1C002.c.1而言，X表示一种或多种合金元素。
text.en: For the purposes of 1C002.c.1, X equals one or more alloying elements.

text.zh: c.1.a. 符合涡轮发动机“零件”或“部件”要求的镍合金（Ni-Al-X、Ni-X-Al），即每109个合金颗粒中，大于100 µm的非金属颗粒（制造过程中引入）少于3个；
text.en: c.1.a. Nickel alloys (Ni-Al-X, Ni-X-Al) qualified for turbine engine “parts” or “components,” i.e., with less than 3 non-metallic particles (introduced during the manufacturing process) larger than 100 µm in 109 alloy particles;

text.zh: c.1.b. 铌合金（Nb-Al-X或Nb-X-Al、Nb-Si-X或Nb-X-Si、Nb-Ti-X或Nb-X-Ti）；
text.en: c.1.b. Niobium alloys (Nb-Al-X or Nb-X-Al, Nb-Si-X or Nb-X-Si, Nb-Ti-X or Nb-X-Ti);

text.zh: c.1.c. 钛合金（Ti-Al-X或Ti-X-Al）；
text.en: c.1.c. Titanium alloys (Ti-Al-X or Ti-X-Al);

text.zh: c.1.d. 铝合金（Al-Mg-X或Al-X-Mg、Al-Zn-X或Al-X-Zn、Al-Fe-X或Al-X-Fe）；或
text.en: c.1.d. Aluminum alloys (Al-Mg-X or Al-X-Mg, Al-Zn-X or Al-X-Zn, Al-Fe-X or Al-X-Fe); or

text.zh: c.1.e. 镁合金（Mg-Al-X或Mg-X-Al）；
text.en: c.1.e. Magnesium alloys (Mg-Al-X or Mg-X-Al);

text.zh: c.2. 在受控环境中采用以下任一种工艺制成：
text.en: c.2. Made in a controlled environment by any of the following processes:

text.zh: c.2.a. ‘真空雾化’；
text.en: c.2.a. 'Vacuum atomization';

text.zh: c.2.b. ‘气体雾化’；
text.en: c.2.b. 'Gas atomization';

text.zh: c.2.c. ‘旋转雾化’；
text.en: c.2.c. 'Rotary atomization';

text.zh: c.2.d. ‘撞击淬冷’；
text.en: c.2.d. 'Splat quenching';

text.zh: c.2.e. ‘熔体旋淬’和‘粉碎’；
text.en: c.2.e. 'Melt spinning' and 'comminution';

text.zh: c.2.f. ‘熔体抽取’和‘粉碎’；
text.en: c.2.f. 'Melt extraction' and 'comminution';

text.zh: c.2.g. ‘机械合金化’；或
text.en: c.2.g. 'Mechanical alloying'; or

text.zh: c.2.h. ‘等离子体雾化’；以及
text.en: c.2.h. 'Plasma atomization'; and

text.zh: c.3. 能够形成1C002.a或1C002.b管制材料；
text.en: c.3. Capable of forming materials controlled by 1C002.a or 1C002.b;

text.zh: d. 具有以下所有特征的合金化材料：
text.en: d. Alloyed materials, having all the following:

text.zh: d.1. 由1C002.c.1规定的任一种组成体系制成；
text.en: d.1. Made from any of the composition systems specified by 1C002.c.1;

text.zh: d.2. 呈未粉碎的薄片、带材或细棒形态；以及
text.en: d.2. In the form of uncomminuted flakes, ribbons or thin rods; and

text.zh: d.3. 在受控环境中采用以下任一种工艺生产：
text.en: d.3. Produced in a controlled environment by any of the following:

text.zh: d.3.a. ‘撞击淬冷’；
text.en: d.3.a. 'Splat quenching';

text.zh: d.3.b. ‘熔体旋淬’；或
text.en: d.3.b. 'Melt spinning'; or

text.zh: d.3.c. ‘熔体抽取’。
text.en: d.3.c. 'Melt extraction'.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Notes:

text.zh: 就1C002而言：
text.en: For the purposes of 1C002:

text.zh: 1. ‘真空雾化’是使熔融金属流暴露于真空，利用溶解气体迅速析出，将其分散为直径500 µm或以下液滴的工艺。
text.en: 1. 'Vacuum atomization' is a process to reduce a molten stream of metal to droplets of a diameter of 500 µm or less by the rapid evolution of a dissolved gas upon exposure to a vacuum.

text.zh: 2. ‘气体雾化’是利用高压气流，将熔融金属合金流分散为直径500 µm或以下液滴的工艺。
text.en: 2. 'Gas atomization' is a process to reduce a molten stream of metal alloy to droplets of 500 µm diameter or less by a high pressure gas stream.

text.zh: 3. ‘旋转雾化’是利用离心力，将熔融金属流或熔池分散为直径500 µm或以下液滴的工艺。
text.en: 3. 'Rotary atomization' is a process to reduce a stream or pool of molten metal to droplets of a diameter of 500 µm or less by centrifugal force.

text.zh: 4. ‘撞击淬冷’是使熔融金属流撞击冷却块而‘快速凝固’，形成片状产品的工艺。
text.en: 4. 'Splat quenching' is a process to 'solidify rapidly' a molten metal stream impinging upon a chilled block, forming a flake-like product.

text.zh: 5. ‘熔体旋淬’是使熔融金属流撞击旋转冷却块而‘快速凝固’，形成片状、带状或棒状产品的工艺。
text.en: 5. 'Melt spinning' is a process to 'solidify rapidly' a molten metal stream impinging upon a rotating chilled block, forming a flake, ribbon or rod-like product.

text.zh: 6. ‘粉碎’是通过破碎或研磨将材料变为颗粒的工艺。
text.en: 6. 'Comminution' is a process to reduce a material to particles by crushing or grinding.

text.zh: 7. ‘熔体抽取’是将旋转冷却块的一小段浸入熔融金属合金浴中，使其‘快速凝固’并抽取带状合金产品的工艺。
text.en: 7. 'Melt extraction' is a process to 'solidify rapidly' and extract a ribbon-like alloy product by the insertion of a short segment of a rotating chilled block into a bath of a molten metal alloy.

text.zh: 8. ‘机械合金化’是通过机械冲击使元素粉末和母合金粉末结合、断裂并再结合的合金化工艺。可通过加入适当粉末将非金属颗粒纳入合金。
text.en: 8. 'Mechanical alloying' is an alloying process resulting from the bonding, fracturing and rebonding of elemental and master alloy powders by mechanical impact. Non-metallic particles may be incorporated in the alloy by addition of the appropriate powders.

text.zh: 9. ‘等离子体雾化’是在惰性气体环境中使用等离子炬，将熔融金属流或固体金属转化为直径500 µm或以下液滴的工艺。
text.en: 9. 'Plasma atomization' is a process to reduce a molten stream or solid metal to droplets of 500 µm diameter or less, using plasma torches in an inert gas environment.

text.zh: 10. 就1C002技术注而言，‘快速凝固’是熔融材料以超过1,000 K/秒的冷却速率凝固的工艺。
text.en: 10. For the purposes of 1C002 Technical Notes, 'solidify rapidly' is a process involving the solidification of molten material at cooling rates exceeding 1000 K/sec.

text.zh: 物项：

text.zh: a. 含有一根或多根铌钛‘细丝’、具有以下所有特征的“超导”“复合”导体：
text.en: a. “Superconductive” “composite” conductors containing one or more niobium-titanium 'filaments', having all of the following:

text.zh: a.1. 嵌入铜或铜基混合“基体”以外的“基体”中；以及
text.en: a.1. Embedded in a “matrix” other than a copper or copper-based mixed “matrix”; and

text.zh: a.2. 横截面积小于0.28 × 10^{−4} mm^{2}（圆形‘细丝’直径为6 µm）；
text.en: a.2. Having a cross-section area less than 0.28 × 10^{−4} mm^{2} (6 µm in diameter for circular 'filaments');

text.zh: b. 由一根或多根非铌钛“超导”‘细丝’构成、具有以下所有特征的“超导”“复合”导体：
text.en: b. “Superconductive” “composite” conductors consisting of one or more “superconductive” 'filaments' other than niobium-titanium, having all of the following:

text.zh: b.1. 零磁感应强度下的“临界温度”高于9.85 K（−263.31 °C）；以及
text.en: b.1. A “critical temperature” at zero magnetic induction exceeding 9.85 K (−263.31 °C); and

text.zh: b.2. 在4.2 K（−268.96 °C）温度下，暴露于垂直导体纵轴的任意方向、磁感应强度为12 T的磁场时，仍保持“超导”状态，且以导体整个横截面积计的临界电流密度大于1,750 A/mm^{2}。
text.en: b.2. Remaining in the “superconductive” state at a temperature of 4.2 K (−268.96 °C) when exposed to a magnetic field oriented in any direction perpendicular to the longitudinal axis of conductor and corresponding to a magnetic induction of 12 T with critical current density exceeding 1750 A/mm^{2} on overall cross-section of the conductor.

text.zh: c. 由一根或多根在高于115 K（−158.16 °C）时仍保持“超导”的“超导”‘细丝’构成的“超导”“复合”导体。
text.en: c. “Superconductive” “composite” conductors consisting of one or more “superconductive” 'filaments' which remain “superconductive” above 115 K (−158.16 °C).

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就1C005而言，‘细丝’可呈线材、圆柱、薄膜、带材或条带形态。
text.en: For the purposes of 1C005, 'filaments' may be in wire, cylinder, film, tape or ribbon form.

text.en: a.4. Aromatic polyetherimides having a 'glass transition temperature (Tg)' exceeding 563 K (290 °C);

text.zh: 1C008.a管制液态或固态“可熔融”形态的物质，包括树脂、粉末、颗粒、薄膜、片材、带材或条带。
text.en: 1C008.a controls the substances in liquid or solid “fusible” form, including resin, powder, pellet, film, sheet, tape, or ribbon.

text.zh: 薄膜、片材、带材或条带形态的非“可熔融”芳香族聚酰亚胺，见ECCN 1A003。

text.zh: b. [保留]
text.en: b. [Reserved]

text.zh: e. 芳撑基团为联苯撑、三联苯撑或其组合的聚芳撑硫醚；
text.en: e. Polyarylene sulfides, where the arylene group is biphenylene, triphenylene or combinations thereof;

text.zh: f. ‘玻璃化转变温度（Tg）’高于563 K（290 °C）的聚联苯醚砜。
text.en: f. Polybiphenylenethersulphone having a 'glass transition temperature (Tg)' exceeding 563 K (290 °C).

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Notes:

text.zh: 1. 就1C008.a.2热塑性材料、1C008.a.4材料和1C008.f材料而言，‘玻璃化转变温度（Tg）’按ISO 11357-2（1999）或国家等效标准所述方法确定。
text.en: 1. For the purposes of 1C008.a.2 thermoplastic materials, 1C008.a.4 materials, and 1C008.f materials, the 'glass transition temperature (Tg)' is determined using the method described in ISO 11357-2 (1999) or national equivalents.

text.zh: 2. 就1C008.a.2热固性材料和1C008.a.3材料而言，‘玻璃化转变温度（Tg）’按ASTM D 7028-07或国家等效标准所述三点弯曲法确定。测试应使用干燥试样，其固化度已达到ASTM E 2160-04或国家等效标准规定的至少90%，并采用能取得最高Tg的标准固化与后固化组合工艺完成固化。
text.en: 2. For the purposes of 1C008.a.2 thermosetting materials and 1C008.a.3 materials, the 'glass transition temperature (Tg)' is determined using the 3-point bend method described in ASTM D 7028-07 or equivalent national standard. The test is to be performed using a dry test specimen which has attained a minimum of 90% degree of cure as specified by ASTM E 2160-04 or equivalent national standard, and was cured using the combination of standard- and post-cure processes that yield the highest Tg.

text.en: List of Items Controlled

text.zh: 相关管制：(1) 本条目管制物项的技术，见ECCN 1E001（“开发”和“生产”）及1E201（“使用”）。(2) 另见ECCN 1C210和1C990。(3) 依据注1或注2不受1C010.e管制的材料，另见9C110。
text.en: Related Controls: (1) See ECCNs 1E001 (“development” and “production”) and 1E201 (“use”) for technology for items controlled by this entry. (2) Also see ECCNs 1C210 and 1C990. (3) See also 9C110 for material not controlled by 1C010.e, as defined by notes 1 or 2.

text.zh: 相关定义：(1) “比模量”：以帕斯卡（等同N/m2）表示的杨氏模量除以以N/m^{3}表示的比重，在温度(296+2) K（(23+2) °C）和相对湿度(50+5)%条件下测量。(2) “比抗拉强度”：以帕斯卡（等同N/m2）表示的极限抗拉强度除以以N/m^{3}表示的比重，在温度(296+2) K（(23+2) °C）和相对湿度(50+5)%条件下测量。
text.en: Related Definitions: (1) “Specific modulus”: Young's modulus in pascals, equivalent to N/m2 divided by specific weight in N/m^{3}, measured at a temperature of (296+2) K ((23+2) °C) and a relative humidity of (50+5) %. (2) “Specific tensile strength”: ultimate tensile strength in pascals, equivalent to N/m2 divided by specific weight in N/m^{3}, measured at a temperature of (296+2) K ((23+2) °C) and a relative humidity of (50+5) %.

text.zh: 物项：
text.en: Items:

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Notes:

text.zh: 1. 计算1C010.a、1C010.b、1C010.c或1C010.e.1.b中“纤维或丝状材料”的“比抗拉强度”“比模量”或比重时，抗拉强度和模量应采用ISO 10618（2004）或国家等效标准所述方法A确定。
text.en: 1. For the purposes of calculating “specific tensile strength”, “specific modulus” or specific weight of “fibrous or filamentary materials” in 1C010.a, 1C010.b, 1C010.c, or 1C010.e.1.b the tensile strength and modulus should be determined by using Method A described in ISO 10618 (2004) or national equivalents.

text.zh: 2. 评估1C010中非单向“纤维或丝状材料”（如织物、无规毡或编织物）的“比抗拉强度”“比模量”或比重时，应依据组成该材料的单向单丝（如单丝、纱线、无捻粗纱或丝束）在加工成非单向“纤维或丝状材料”之前的力学性能。
text.en: 2. For the purposes of assessing the “specific tensile strength”, “specific modulus” or specific weight of non-unidirectional “fibrous or filamentary materials” (e.g., fabrics, random mats or braids) in 1C010, this is to be based on the mechanical properties of the constituent unidirectional monofilaments (e.g., monofilaments, yarns, rovings or tows) prior to processing into the non-unidirectional “fibrous or filamentary materials”.

text.zh: a. 具有以下所有特征的有机“纤维或丝状材料”：
text.en: a. Organic “fibrous or filamentary materials”, having all of the following:
a.1. “Specific modulus” exceeding 12.7 × 10^{6} m; and
a.2. “Specific tensile strength” exceeding 23.5 × 10^{4} m;

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 1C010.a不管制聚乙烯。
text.en: 1C010.a does not control polyethylene.

text.zh: b. 具有以下所有特征的碳“纤维或丝状材料”：
text.en: b. Carbon “fibrous or filamentary materials”, having all of the following:
b.1. “Specific modulus” exceeding 14.65 × 10^{6} m; and
b.2. “Specific tensile strength” exceeding 26.82 × 10^{4} m;

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 1C010.b不管制：
text.en: 1C010.b does not control:

text.zh: a. 用于维修“民用航空器”结构或层压制品，且具有以下所有特征的“纤维或丝状材料”：
text.en: a. “Fibrous or filamentary materials”, for the repair of “civil aircraft” structures or laminates, having all of the following:

text.zh: 1. 面积不超过1 m^{2}；
text.en: 1. An area not exceeding 1 m^{2};

text.zh: 2. 长度不超过2.5米；以及
text.en: 2. A length not exceeding 2.5 m; and

text.zh: 3. 宽度大于15毫米。
text.en: 3. A width exceeding 15 mm.

text.zh: b. 经机械切碎、研磨或切断，且长度为25.0毫米或以下的碳“纤维或丝状材料”。
text.en: b. Mechanically chopped, milled or cut carbon “fibrous or filamentary materials” 25.0 mm or less in length.

text.zh: c. 具有以下所有特征的无机“纤维或丝状材料”：
text.en: c. Inorganic “fibrous or filamentary materials”, having all of the following:

text.zh: c.1. 具有以下任一特征：
text.en: c.1. Having any of the following:

text.zh: c.1.a. 二氧化硅（SiO_{2}）重量含量为50%或以上，且“比模量”大于2.54 × 10^{6}米；或
text.en: c.1.a. Composed of 50% or more by weight silicon dioxide (SiO_{2}) and having a “specific modulus” exceeding 2.54 × 10^{6} m; or

text.zh: c.1.b. 不属于1C010.c.1.a规定范围，且“比模量”大于5.6 × 10^{6}米；以及
text.en: c.1.b. Not specified in 1C010.c.1.a and having a “specific modulus” exceeding 5.6 × 10^{6} m; and

text.zh: c.2. 在惰性环境中的熔点、软化点、分解点或升华点高于1,922 K（1,649 °C）；
text.en: c.2. Melting, softening, decomposition or sublimation point exceeding 1,922 K (1,649 °C) in an inert environment;

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 1C010.c不管制：
text.en: 1C010.c does not control:

text.zh: a. 呈短切纤维或无规毡形态、不连续、多相、多晶的氧化铝纤维，其二氧化硅重量含量为3%或以上，且“比模量”小于10 × 10^{6}米；
text.en: a. Discontinuous, multiphase, polycrystalline alumina fibers in chopped fiber or random mat form, containing 3% by weight or more silica, with a “specific modulus” of less than 10 × 10^{6} m;

text.zh: b. 钼和钼合金纤维；
text.en: b. Molybdenum and molybdenum alloy fibers;

text.zh: c. 硼纤维；
text.en: c. Boron fibers;

text.zh: d. 在惰性环境中熔点、软化点、分解点或升华点低于2,043 K（1,770 °C）的不连续陶瓷纤维。
text.en: d. Discontinuous ceramic fibers with a melting, softening, decomposition or sublimation point lower than 2,043 K (1,770 °C) in an inert environment.

text.zh: d. 具有以下任一特征的“纤维或丝状材料”：
text.en: d. “Fibrous or filamentary materials”, having any of the following:

text.zh: d.1. 由以下任一种材料组成：
text.en: d.1. Composed of any of the following:

text.zh: d.1.a. 1C008.a管制的聚醚酰亚胺；或
text.en: d.1.a. Polyetherimides controlled by 1C008.a; or

text.zh: d.1.b. 1C008.b至1C008.f管制的材料；或
text.en: d.1.b. Materials controlled by 1C008.b to 1C008.f; or

text.zh: d.2. 由1C010.d.1.a或1C010.d.1.b管制材料组成，并与1C010.a、1C010.b或1C010.c管制的其他纤维‘混纤’；
text.en: d.2. Composed of materials controlled by 1C010.d.1.a or 1C010.d.1.b and 'commingled' with other fibers controlled by 1C010.a, 1C010.b or 1C010.c;

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就1C010.d.2而言，‘混纤’是将热塑性纤维与增强纤维逐丝混合，以形成完全呈纤维形态的纤维增强“基体”混合物。
text.en: For the purposes of 1C010.d.2, 'commingled' is filament to filament blending of thermoplastic fibers and reinforcement fibers in order to produce a fiber reinforcement “matrix” mix in total fiber form.

text.zh: e. 完全或部分浸渍树脂或沥青的“纤维或丝状材料”（预浸料）、金属或碳涂覆的“纤维或丝状材料”（预成型件），或‘碳纤维预成型件’，具有以下所有特征：
text.en: e. Fully or partially resin impregnated or pitch impregnated “fibrous or filamentary materials” (prepregs), metal or carbon coated “fibrous or filamentary materials” (preforms) or 'carbon fiber preforms', having all of the following:

text.zh: e.1. 具有以下任一项：
text.en: e.1. Having any of the following:

text.zh: e.1.a. 1C010.c管制的无机“纤维或丝状材料”；或
text.en: e.1.a. Inorganic “fibrous or filamentary materials” controlled by 1C010.c; or

text.zh: e.1.b. 具有以下所有特征的有机或碳“纤维或丝状材料”：
text.en: e.1.b. Organic or carbon “fibrous or filamentary materials”, having all of the following:
e.1.b.1. “Specific modulus” exceeding 10.15 × 10^{6} m; and
e.1.b.2 “Specific tensile strength” exceeding 17.7 × 10^{4}m; and

text.zh: e.2. 具有以下任一项：
text.en: e.2. Having any of the following:

text.zh: e.2.a. 1C008或1C009.b管制的树脂或沥青；
text.en: e.2.a. Resin or pitch, controlled by 1C008 or 1C009.b;

text.zh: e.2.b. ‘动态力学分析玻璃化转变温度（DMA T_{g}）’等于或高于453 K（180 °C），并含有酚醛树脂；或
text.en: e.2.b. 'Dynamic Mechanical Analysis glass transition temperature (DMA T_{g})' equal to or exceeding 453 K (180 °C) and having a phenolic resin; or

text.zh: e.2.c. ‘动态力学分析玻璃化转变温度（DMA T_{g}）’等于或高于505 K（232 °C），并含有1C008或1C009.b未规定且不属于酚醛树脂的树脂或沥青；
text.en: e.2.c. 'Dynamic Mechanical Analysis glass transition temperature (DMA T_{g})' equal to or exceeding 505 K (232 °C) and having a resin or pitch, not specified by 1C008 or 1C009.b, and not being a phenolic resin;
Note 1:

text.zh: 未浸渍树脂或沥青的金属或碳涂覆“纤维或丝状材料”（预成型件）或‘碳纤维预成型件’，属于1C010.a、1C010.b或1C010.c中“纤维或丝状材料”的规定范围。
text.en: Metal or carbon coated “fibrous or filamentary materials” (preforms) or 'carbon fiber preforms', not impregnated with resin or pitch, are specified by “fibrous or filamentary materials” in 1C010.a, 1C010.b or 1C010.c.

text.zh: 注2：1C010.e不适用于：
text.en: Note 2: 1C010.e does not apply to:

text.zh: a. 用于维修“民用航空器”结构或层压制品、具有以下所有特征的环氧树脂“基体”浸渍碳“纤维或丝状材料”（预浸料）：
text.en: a. Epoxy resin “matrix” impregnated carbon “fibrous or filamentary materials” (prepregs) for the repair of “civil aircraft” structures or laminates, having all of the following:

text.zh: 1. 面积不超过1 m^{2}
text.en: 1. An area not exceeding 1 m^{2}

text.zh: 2. 长度不超过2.5米；以及
text.en: 2. A length not exceeding 2.5 m; and

text.zh: 3. 宽度大于15毫米；
text.en: 3. A width exceeding 15 mm;

text.zh: b. 经机械切碎、研磨或切断、长度为25.0毫米或以下、完全或部分浸渍树脂或沥青的碳“纤维或丝状材料”，且所用树脂或沥青不属于1C008或1C009.b规定者。
text.en: b. Fully or partially resin-impregnated or pitch-impregnated mechanically chopped, milled or cut carbon “fibrous or filamentary materials” 25.0 mm or less in length when using a resin or pitch other than those specified by 1C008 or 1C009.b.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Notes:

text.zh: 1. 就1C010.e及注1而言，‘碳纤维预成型件’是涂覆或未涂覆纤维的有序排列，拟在引入“基体”形成“复合材料”之前构成零件的骨架。
text.en: 1. For the purposes of 1C010.e and Note 1, 'carbon fiber preforms' are an ordered arrangement of uncoated or coated fibers intended to constitute a framework of a part before the “matrix” is introduced to form a “composite”.

text.zh: 2. 就1C010.e.2而言，‘动态力学分析玻璃化转变温度（DMA Tg）’采用ASTM D 7028-07或国家等效标准所述方法，在干燥试样上确定。对于热固性材料，干燥试样的固化度须至少达到ASTM E 2160-04或国家等效标准定义的90%。
text.en: 2. For the purposes of 1C010.e.2, 'Dynamic Mechanical Analysis glass transition temperature (DMA Tg)' is determined using the method described in ASTM D 7028 -07, or equivalent national standard, on a dry test specimen. In the case of thermoset materials, degree of cure of a dry test specimen shall be a minimum of 90% as defined by ASTM E 2160 04 or equivalent national standard.

text.en: List of Items Controlled

text.zh: 相关管制：(1) 另见1C004、1C007和1C298。(2) 对于符合ITAR《联邦法规》第22编§120.3防务物品定义的商品，ITAR描述了“受ITAR管辖”的类似商品（见第22编第120至130部分，包括USML第XIII类）。(3) “特殊裂变材料”和“其他裂变材料”受核管理委员会出口许可权限管辖，但装在仪器传感部件中且为4“有效克”或以下者除外（见《联邦法规》第10编第110部分）。
text.en: Related Controls: (1) See also 1C004, 1C007, and 1C298. (2) For commodities that meet the definition of defense articles under 22 CFR 120.3 of the ITAR, which describes similar commodities “subject to the ITAR” (See 22 CFR parts 120 through 130, including USML Category XIII). (3) “Special fissile materials” and “other fissile materials”; except, four “effective grams” or less when contained in a sensing component in instruments are subject to the export licensing authority of the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (see 10 CFR part 110).

text.zh: 相关定义：不适用
text.en: Related Definitions: N/A

text.zh: 物项：a. 在15 °C测量体密度为1.72 g/cm^{3}或以上、粒径为100微米或以下，可用于火箭喷管和再入飞行器鼻尖的下列细晶石墨：
text.en: Items: a. Fine grain graphites with a bulk density of 1.72 g/cm^{3} or greater, measured at 15 °C, and having a grain size of 100 micrometers or less, usable for rocket nozzles and reentry vehicle nose tips as follows:

text.zh: a.1. 直径为120毫米或以上、长度为50毫米或以上的圆柱体；
text.en: a.1. Cylinders having a diameter of 120 mm or greater and a length of 50 mm or greater;

text.zh: a.2. 内径为65毫米或以上、壁厚为25毫米或以上且长度为50毫米或以上的管材；
text.en: a.2. Tubes having an inner diameter of 65 mm or greater and a wall thickness of 25 mm or greater and a length of 50 mm or greater;

text.zh: a.3. 尺寸为120毫米 × 120毫米 × 50毫米或以上的块材。
text.en: a.3. Blocks having a size of 120 mm × 120 mm × 50 mm or greater.

text.zh: b. 可用于火箭喷管和再入飞行器鼻尖的热解石墨或纤维增强石墨；
text.en: b. Pyrolytic or fibrous reinforced graphites, usable for rocket nozzles and reentry vehicle nose tips;

text.zh: c. 用于可供“航程”等于或大于300千米的火箭、导弹和无人驾驶航空器使用的雷达罩的陶瓷复合材料（在100 MHz至100 GHz之间任一频率下介电常数小于6）；或
text.en: c. Ceramic composite materials (dielectric constant is less than 6 at any frequency from 100 MHz to 100 GHz) for use in radomes useable in rockets, missiles, and unmanned aerial vehicles capable of achieving a “range” equal to or greater than 300 km; or

text.zh: d. 可用于“航程”等于或大于300千米的火箭、导弹和无人驾驶航空器的下列高温陶瓷材料：
text.en: d. High-temperature ceramic materials, useable in rockets, missiles, and unmanned aerial vehicles capable of achieving a “range” equal to or greater than 300 km, as follows:

text.zh: d.1. 可用于鼻尖、可整体机加工的碳化硅增强未烧结陶瓷。
text.en: d.1. Bulk machinable silicon-carbide reinforced unfired ceramic, usable for nose tips.

text.zh: d.2. 可用于鼻尖、再入飞行器及喷管瓣片的增强碳化硅陶瓷复合材料。
text.en: d.2. Reinforced silicon-carbide ceramic composites usable for nose tips, re-entry vehicles, nozzle flaps.

text.zh: d.3. 由熔点等于或高于3,000 °C的‘超高温陶瓷（UHTC）’基体组成、以纤维或丝增强、可整体机加工并可用于导弹部件（如鼻尖、再入飞行器、前缘、燃气舵、控制面或火箭发动机喉衬）的陶瓷复合材料。
text.en: d.3. Bulk machinable ceramic composite materials consisting of an 'Ultra High Temperature Ceramic (UHTC)' matrix with a melting point equal to or greater than 3000 °C and reinforced with fibers or filaments, usable for missile components (such as nose tips, re-entry vehicles, leading edges, jet vanes, control surfaces, or rocket motor throat inserts).

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: ECCN 1C107.d.3不管制非复合形态的‘超高温陶瓷（UHTC）’材料。
text.en: ECCN 1C107.d.3. does not control 'Ultra High Temperature Ceramic (UHTC)' materials in non-composite form.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: ‘超高温陶瓷（UHTC）’包括：二硼化钛（TiB_{2}）、二硼化锆（ZrB_{2}）、二硼化铌（NbB_{2}）、二硼化铪（HfB_{2}）、二硼化钽（TaB_{2}）、碳化钛（TiC）、碳化锆（ZrC）、碳化铌（NbC）、碳化铪（HfC）和碳化钽（TaC）。
text.en: 'Ultra High Temperature Ceramics (UHTC)' includes: Titanium diboride (TiB_{2}), zirconium diboride (ZrB_{2}), niobium diboride (NbB_{2}), hafnium diboride (HfB_{2}), tantalum diboride (TaB_{2}), titanium carbide (TiC), zirconium carbide (ZrC), niobium carbide (NbC), hafnium carbide (HfC), tantalum carbide (TaC).

text.zh: 相关管制：(1) 羟基官能度等于或大于2.2且小于或等于2.4、羟值小于0.77 meq/g、30 °C黏度小于47泊的HTPB（端羟基聚丁二烯）（CAS 69102-90-5）的管制，见USML第V(e)(7)类。(2) 二茂铁衍生物（包括butacene）的管制，见USML第V类。(3) 由氟以及其他卤素、氧或氮组成的氧化剂的管制，见ECCN 1C608；但三氟化氯除外，其受本ECCN 1C111.a.3.f管制。(4) 不受本ECCN 1C111.a.2.b管制的硼和硼合金，见ECCN 1C011.b。(5) 抑制型红发烟硝酸（IRFNA）（CAS 8007-58-7）的管制，见USML第V类。
text.en: Related Controls: (1) See USML Category V(e)(7) for controls on HTPB (hydroxyl terminated polybutadiene) with a hydroxyl functionality equal to or greater than 2.2 and less than or equal to 2.4, a hydroxyl value of less than 0.77 meq/g, and a viscosity at 30 °C of less than 47 poise (CAS #69102-90-5). (2) See USML Category V for controls on ferrocene derivatives, including butacene. (3) See ECCN 1C608 for controls on oxidizers that are composed of fluorine and also other halogens, oxygen, or nitrogen, except for chlorine trifluoride, which is controlled under this ECCN 1C111.a.3.f. (4) See ECCN 1C011.b for controls on boron and boron alloys not controlled under this ECCN 1C111.a.2.b. (5) See USML Category V for controls on Inhibited Red Fuming Nitric Acid (IRFNA) (CAS 8007-58-7).

text.zh: 相关定义：粒径是按重量或体积计算的平均颗粒直径。取样和确定粒径时必须采用最佳工业实践，不得通过添加较大或较小粒径材料改变平均直径而规避管制。
text.en: Related Definitions: Particle size is the mean particle diameter on a weight or volume basis. Best industrial practices must be used in sampling, and in determining particle size, and the controls may not be undermined by the addition of larger or smaller sized material to shift the mean diameter.

text.zh: 物项：
text.en: Items:

text.zh: a. 推进物质：
text.en: a. Propulsive substances:

text.zh: a.1. 粒径小于200 × 10^{−6}米（200 µm）、铝重量含量为97%或以上的球形或类球形铝粉（CAS 7429-90-5），且依据ISO 2591-1:1988或国家等效标准，总重量中至少10%由小于63 µm的颗粒组成。
text.en: a.1. Spherical or spheroidal aluminum powder (C.A.S. 7429-90-5) in particle size of less than 200 × 10^{−6} m (200 µm) and an aluminum content of 97% by weight or more, if at least 10% of the total weight is made up of particles of less than 63 µm, according to ISO 2591-1:1988 or national equivalents.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 63 µm粒径（ISO R-565）对应250目（Tyler）或230目（ASTM E-11标准）。
text.en: A particle size of 63 µm (ISO R-565) corresponds to 250 mesh (Tyler) or 230 mesh (ASTM standard E-11).

text.zh: a.2. 下列金属粉末和合金，无论球形、雾化、类球形、片状或研磨形态，其中按颗粒体积或重量计，全部颗粒中至少90%由小于60 µ的颗粒组成（通过筛分、激光衍射或光学扫描等测量技术确定）：
text.en: a.2. Metal powders and alloys where at least 90% of the total particles by particle volume or weight are made up of particles of less than 60 µ (determined by measurement techniques such as using a sieve, laser diffraction or optical scanning), whether spherical, atomized, spheroidal, flaked or ground, as follows:

text.zh: a.2.a. 按重量计含有97%或以上的以下任一种物质：
text.en: a.2.a. Consisting of 97% by weight or more of any of the following:
a.2.a.2. Beryllium (C.A.S. #7440-41-7); or

text.zh: a.2.b. 硼重量含量为85%或以上的硼或硼合金。
text.en: a.2.b. Boron or boron alloys with a boron content of 85% or more by weight.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 锆中天然存在的铪含量（通常为2%至7%）计入锆含量。
text.en: The natural content of hafnium in the zirconium (typically 2% to 7%) is counted with the zirconium.

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 在多峰颗粒分布（如不同粒径混合物）中，如一个或多个峰的颗粒受管制，则整个粉末混合物均受管制。
text.en: In a multimodal particle distribution (e.g., mixtures of different grain sizes) in which one or more modes are controlled, the entire powder mixture is controlled.

text.zh: a.3. 可用于液体推进剂火箭发动机的下列氧化剂物质：
text.en: a.3. Oxidizer substances usable in liquid propellant rocket engines, as follows:
a.3.a. Dinitrogen trioxide (CAS 10544-73-7);
a.3.b. Nitrogen dioxide (CAS 10102-44-0)/dinitrogen tetroxide (CAS 10544-72-6);
a.3.c. Dinitrogen pentoxide (CAS 10102-03-1);

text.zh: a.3.d. 混合氮氧化物（MON）；
text.en: a.3.d. Mixed oxides of nitrogen (MON);
a.3.e. [Reserved];

text.zh: a.3.f. 三氟化氯（ClF_{3}）。
text.en: a.3.f. Chlorine trifluoride (ClF_{3}).

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 混合氮氧化物（MON）是一氧化氮（NO）在四氧化二氮/二氧化氮（N_{2}O_{4}/NO_{2}）中的溶液，可用于导弹系统。其具有一系列组成，可表示为MONi或MONij，其中i和j为表示混合物中一氧化氮百分比的整数（例如MON3含3%一氧化氮，MON25含25%一氧化氮；上限为MON40，即重量含量40%）。
text.en: Mixed oxides of nitrogen (MON) are solutions of nitric oxide (NO) in dinitrogen tetroxide/nitrogen dioxide (N_{2}O_{4}/NO_{2}) that can be used in missile systems. There are a range of compositions that can be denoted as MONi or MONij, where i and j are integers representing the percentage of nitric oxide in the mixture (e.g., MON3 contains 3% nitric oxide, MON25 25% nitric oxide. An upper limit is MON40, 40% by weight).

text.zh: b. 聚合物物质：
text.en: b. Polymeric substances:

text.zh: b.1. 羧基封端聚丁二烯（包括端羧基聚丁二烯）（CTPB）；
text.en: b.1. Carboxy-terminated polybutadiene (including carboxyl-terminated polybutadiene) (CTPB);

text.zh: b.2. 羟基封端聚丁二烯（包括端羟基聚丁二烯）（HTPB）（CAS 69102-90-5），但USML第V类规定的端羟基聚丁二烯除外（见《联邦法规》第22编§121.1）（另见本ECCN相关管制注1）；
text.en: b.2. Hydroxy-terminated polybutadiene (including hydroxyl-terminated polybutadiene) (HTPB) (CAS 69102-90-5), except for hydroxyl-terminated polybutadiene as specified in USML Category V (see 22 CFR 121.1) (also see Related Controls Note #1 for this ECCN);

text.zh: b.3. 聚丁二烯—丙烯酸共聚物（PBAA）；
text.en: b.3. Polybutadiene acrylic acid (PBAA);

text.zh: b.4. 聚丁二烯—丙烯酸—丙烯腈共聚物（PBAN）（CAS 25265-19-4/CAS 68891-50-9）；
text.en: b.4. Polybutadiene acrylic acid acrylonitrile (PBAN) (CAS 25265-19-4/CAS 68891-50-9);

text.zh: b.5. 聚四氢呋喃—聚乙二醇（TPEG）。
text.en: b.5. Polytetrahydrofuran polyethylene glycol (TPEG).

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 聚四氢呋喃—聚乙二醇（TPEG）是聚1,4-丁二醇（CAS 110-63-4）与聚乙二醇（PEG）（CAS 25322-68-3）的嵌段共聚物。
text.en: Polytetrahydrofuran polyethylene glycol (TPEG) is a block copolymer of poly 1,4-Butanediol (CAS 110-63-4) and polyethylene glycol (PEG) (CAS 25322-68-3).

text.zh: c. 其他推进剂含能材料、添加剂或助剂：
text.en: c. Other propellant energetic materials, additives, or agents:
c.1. [Reserved]

text.zh: c.2. 三乙二醇二硝酸酯（TEGDN）；
text.en: c.2. Triethylene glycol dinitrate (TEGDN);

text.zh: c.3. 2-硝基二苯胺（2-NDPA）；
text.en: c.3. 2 Nitrodiphenylamine (2-NDPA);

text.zh: c.4. 三羟甲基乙烷三硝酸酯（TMETN）；
text.en: c.4. Trimethylolethane trinitrate (TMETN);

text.zh: c.5. 二乙二醇二硝酸酯（DEGDN）。
text.en: c.5. Diethylene glycol dinitrate (DEGDN).

text.zh: d. 下列肼及其衍生物：
text.en: d. Hydrazine and derivatives as follows:

text.zh: d.1. 浓度为70%或以上的肼（CAS 302-01-2）；
text.en: d.1. Hydrazine (C.A.S. #302-01-2) in concentrations of 70% or more;

text.zh: d.2. 一甲基肼（MMH）（CAS 60-34-4）；
text.en: d.2. Monomethyl hydrazine (MMH) (C.A.S. #60-34-4);

text.zh: d.3. 对称二甲基肼（SDMH）（CAS 540-73-8）；
text.en: d.3. Symmetrical dimethyl hydrazine (SDMH) (C.A.S. #540-73-8);

text.zh: d.4. 偏二甲肼（UDMH）（CAS 57-14-7）；
text.en: d.4. Unsymmetrical dimethyl hydrazine (UDMH) (C.A.S. #57-14-7);
d.5. Trimethylhydrazine (C.A.S. #1741-01-1);
d.6. Tetramethylhydrazine (C.A.S. #6415-12-9);
d.7. N,N diallylhydrazine (CAS 5164-11-4);
d.8. Allylhydrazine (C.A.S. #7422-78-8);
d.9. Ethylene dihydrazine (CAS 6068-98-0);

text.zh: d.10. 一甲基肼二硝酸盐；
text.en: d.10. Monomethylhydrazine dinitrate;

text.zh: d.11. 偏二甲肼硝酸盐；
text.en: d.11. Unsymmetrical dimethylhydrazine nitrate;
d.12. 1,1-Dimethylhydrazinium azide (CAS 227955-52-4)/1,2-Dimethylhydrazinium azide (CAS 299177-50-7);
d.13. Hydrazinium azide (C.A.S. #14546-44-2);
d.14. Hydrazinium dinitrate (CAS 13464-98-7);

text.zh: d.15. 二亚胺草酸二肼（CAS 3457-37-2）；
text.en: d.15. Diimido oxalic acid dihydrazine (C.A.S. #3457-37-2);

text.zh: d.16. 2-羟乙基肼硝酸盐（HEHN）；
text.en: d.16. 2-hydroxyethylhydrazine nitrate (HEHN);
d.17. Hydrazinium diperchlorate (C.A.S. #13812-39-0);

text.zh: d.18. 甲基肼硝酸盐（MHN）（CAS 29674-96-2）；
text.en: d.18. Methylhydrazine nitrate (MHN) (CAS 29674-96-2);

text.zh: d.19. 1,1-二乙基肼硝酸盐（DEHN）/1,2-二乙基肼硝酸盐（DEHN）（CAS 363453-17-2）；
text.en: d.19. 1,1-Diethylhydrazine nitrate (DEHN)/1,2-Diethylhydrazine nitrate (DEHN) (CAS 363453-17-2);

text.zh: d.20. 3,6-二肼基四嗪硝酸盐（DHTN），亦称1,4-二肼硝酸盐。
text.en: d.20. 3,6-dihydrazino tetrazine nitrate (DHTN), also referred to as 1,4-dihydrazine nitrate.

text.zh: e. 下列肼替代燃料：
text.en: e. Hydrazine replacement fuels as follows:

text.zh: e.1. 2-二甲氨基乙基叠氮化物（DMAZ）（CAS 86147-04-8）；
text.en: e.1. 2-Dimethylaminoethylazide (DMAZ) (CAS 86147-04-8);
e.2. [Reserved]

text.zh: 相关管制：(1) 本条目管制物项的技术，见ECCN 1E001（“开发”和“生产”）及1E101（“使用”）。(2) 另见ECCN 1C216。(3) 为分离铀同位素而“专门设计”或制备的马氏体时效钢实物形态及成品，受核管理委员会出口许可权限管辖（见《联邦法规》第10编第110部分）。
text.en: Related Controls: (1) See ECCNs 1E001 (“development” and “production”) and 1E101 (“use”) for technology for items controlled by this entry. (2) Also see ECCN 1C216. (3) Maraging steel, in physical forms and finished products and “specially designed” or prepared for use in separating uranium isotopes, is subject to the export licensing authority of the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (see 10 CFR part 110).

text.zh: 物项：a. 在20 °C测量的极限抗拉强度等于或大于：
text.en: Items: a. Having an ultimate tensile strength, measured at 20 °C, equal to or greater than:

text.zh: a.1. 固溶退火状态下0.9 GPa；或
text.en: a.1. 0.9 GPa in the solution annealed stage; or

text.zh: a.2. 沉淀硬化状态下1.5 GPa；以及
text.en: a.2. 1.5 GPa in the precipitation hardened stage; and

text.zh: b. 以下任一种形态：
text.en: b. Any of the following forms:

text.zh: b.1 壁厚或板厚等于或小于5.0毫米的薄板、厚板或管材；
text.en: b.1 Sheet, plate or tubing with a wall or plate thickness equal to or less than 5.0 mm;

text.zh: 或
text.en: or

text.zh: b.2 壁厚等于或小于50毫米且内径等于或大于270毫米的管状形态。
text.en: b.2 Tubular forms with a wall thickness equal to or less than 50 mm and having an inner diameter equal to or greater than 270 mm.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 马氏体时效钢是通常具有以下特征的铁合金：
text.en: Maraging steels are iron alloys that are generally:

text.zh: a. 镍含量高、碳含量极低，使用置换元素或析出物使合金强化和时效硬化；以及
text.en: a. Characterized by high nickel, very low carbon content and use substitutional elements or precipitates to produce strengthening and age-hardening of the alloy; and

text.zh: b. 通过热处理循环促进马氏体转变过程（固溶退火阶段），随后进行时效硬化（沉淀硬化阶段）。
text.en: b. Subjected to heat treatment cycles to facilitate the martensitic transformation process (solution annealed stage) and subsequently age hardened (precipitation hardened stage).

text.en: Related Controls: (1) See ECCNs 1E001 (“development” and “production”) and 1E201 (“use”) for technology for items controlled by this entry. (2) Also see ECCN 1C002. (3) Aluminum alloys and titanium alloys, in physical forms and finished products and “specially designed” or prepared for use in separating uranium isotopes, are subject to the export licensing authority of the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (see 10 CFR part 110).

text.zh: 相关定义：“能够达到”一语适用于热处理前或热处理后的铝合金和钛合金。
text.en: Related Definitions: The phrase “capable of” refers to aluminum alloys and titanium alloys either before or after heat treatment.

text.zh: 物项：a. 同时具有以下两项特征的铝合金：

text.zh: a.1. 在293 K（20 °C）下“能够达到”460 MPa或以上极限抗拉强度；以及
text.en: a.1. “Capable of” an ultimate tensile strength of 460 MPa or more at 293 K (20 °C); and

text.zh: a.2. 呈外径大于75毫米的管状或实心圆柱形态（包括锻件）；
text.en: a.2. In the form of tubes or cylindrical solid forms (including forgings) with an outside diameter of more than 75 mm;

text.zh: b. 同时具有以下两项特征的钛合金：
text.en: b. Titanium alloys having both of the following characteristics:

text.zh: b.1. 在293 K（20 °C）下“能够达到”900 MPa或以上极限抗拉强度；以及
text.en: b.1. “Capable of” an ultimate tensile strength of 900 MPa or more at 293 K (20 °C); and

text.zh: b.2. 呈外径大于75毫米的管状或实心圆柱形态（包括锻件）。
text.en: b.2. In the form of tubes or cylindrical solid forms (including forgings) with an outside diameter of more than 75 mm.

text.en: Related Controls: (1) See ECCNs 1E001 (“development” and “production”) and 1E201 (“use”) for technology for items controlled by this entry. (2) Also see ECCNs 1C010 and 1C990.

text.zh: 相关定义：就本条目而言，“纤维或丝状材料”仅限于连续“单丝”“纱线”“无捻粗纱”“丝束”或“带材”。本条目所用其他术语定义如下：
text.en: Related Definitions: For the purpose of this entry, the term “fibrous or filamentary materials” is restricted to continuous “monofilaments”, “yarns”, “rovings”, “tows”, or “tapes”. Definitions for other terms used in this entry:

text.zh: 丝或单丝是纤维的最小单位，通常直径为数微米。
text.en: Filament or Monofilament is the smallest increment of fiber, usually several µm in diameter.

text.zh: 股是大致平行排列的一束单丝（通常超过200根）。
text.en: Strand is a bundle of filaments (typically over 200) arranged approximately parallel.

text.zh: 无捻粗纱是一束大致平行排列的股（通常为12—120股）。
text.en: Roving is a bundle (typically 12-120) of approximately parallel strands.

text.zh: 纱线是一束加捻的股。
text.en: Yarn is a bundle of twisted strands.

text.zh: 丝束是一束通常大致平行的单丝。
text.en: Tow is a bundle of filaments, usually approximately parallel.

text.zh: 带材是由交织或单向的单丝、股、无捻粗纱、丝束或纱线等构成的材料，通常已预浸树脂。
text.en: Tape is a material constructed of interlaced or unidirectional filaments, strands, rovings, tows, or yarns, etc., usually preimpregnated with resin.

text.zh: 比模量是以N/m^{2}表示的杨氏模量除以以N/m^{3}表示的比重，在温度(296 ±2) K（(23 ±2) °C）和相对湿度50 ±5%条件下测量。
text.en: Specific modulus is the Young's modulus in N/m^{2} divided by the specific weight in N/m^{3}, measured at a temperature of (296 ±2) K ((23 ±2) °C) and a relative humidity of 50 ±5 percent.

text.zh: 比抗拉强度是以N/m^{2}表示的极限抗拉强度除以以N/m^{3}表示的比重，在温度(296 ±2) K（(23 ±2) °C）和相对湿度50 ±5%条件下测量。
text.en: Specific tensile strength is the ultimate tensile strength in N/m^{2} divided by specific weight in N/m^{3}, measured at a temperature of (296 ±2) K ((23 ±2) °C) and a relative humidity of 50 ±5 percent.

text.zh: 物项：a. “比模量”为12.7 × 10^{6}米或以上，或“比抗拉强度”为235 × 10^{3}米或以上的碳或芳纶“纤维或丝状材料”；但含有重量占比0.25%或以上的酯类纤维表面改性剂的芳纶“纤维或丝状材料”除外；
text.en: Items: a. Carbon or aramid “fibrous or filamentary materials” having a “specific modulus” of 12.7 × 10^{6} m or greater or a “specific tensile strength” of 235 × 10^{3} m or greater except Aramid “fibrous or filamentary materials” having 0.25 percent or more by weight of an ester based fiber surface modifier;

text.zh: b. “比模量”为3.18 × 10^{6}米或以上，且“比抗拉强度”为76.2 × 10^{3}米或以上的玻璃“纤维或丝状材料”；或
text.en: b. Glass “fibrous or filamentary materials” having a “specific modulus” of 3.18 × 10^{6} m or greater and a “specific tensile strength” of 76.2 × 10^{3} m or greater; or

text.zh: c. 由1C210.a或.b管制碳或玻璃“纤维或丝状材料”制成、经热固性树脂浸渍的连续“纱线”“无捻粗纱”“丝束”或宽度不大于15毫米的“带材”（预浸料）。
text.en: c. Thermoset resin impregnated continuous “yarns”, “rovings”, “tows” or “tapes” with a width no greater than 15 mm (prepregs), made from carbon or glass “fibrous or filamentary materials” controlled by 1C210.a or .b.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 树脂构成复合材料的基体。
text.en: The resin forms the matrix of the composite.
